title: The id_token is verified against the provider's JWKS and refused on any invariant failure
asA: operator signing in through an OIDC-declared provider
iWant: the flow controller to verify the id_token's signature, issuer, audience, expiry, and nonce before any session issue
soThat: a forged or replayed id_token cannot be turned into a project session

acceptanceCriteria.description: A valid id_token from the mock OIDC provider passes verification: signature valid against JWKS, iss equals the provider's issuer, aud contains the client_id, exp in the future, nonce equals the pending-flow's stored nonce.
acceptanceCriteria.given: a successful sign-in flow through the mock OIDC provider
acceptanceCriteria.when: the flow controller invokes its verifier module on the returned id_token
acceptanceCriteria.then: the verifier returns `{ valid: true, claims: { iss, aud, sub, exp, nonce } }`; the flow proceeds to session issue; the audit log records one `oauth2.id_token_verified` event carrying provider id and no token value

acceptanceCriteria.description: An id_token signed by an unknown key is refused with a distinct stable-coded reason and no session issue.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the mock provider is configured to sign one token exchange with a key not published on JWKS
acceptanceCriteria.when: the callback reaches the flow controller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_ID_TOKEN_SIGNATURE_INVALID`; no session cookie is set; the audit log records one `oauth2.id_token_refused` event carrying provider id, reason class `signature`, and no token value

acceptanceCriteria.description: An id_token whose iss does not equal the provider's declared issuer is refused with a distinct stable-coded reason.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the mock provider is configured to mint a token whose `iss` claim is a URL other than the declared `issuer`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the callback reaches the flow controller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_ID_TOKEN_ISSUER_MISMATCH`; no session cookie is set; the audit log records one `oauth2.id_token_refused` event carrying provider id, reason class `issuer`, and no token value

acceptanceCriteria.description: A missing id_token in a response from a provider declared as OIDC terminates the flow with a distinct stable-coded reason.
acceptanceCriteria.given: the mock provider is configured to omit the `id_token` field from one token response and remains declared as `providerKind: oidc`
acceptanceCriteria.when: the callback reaches the flow controller
acceptanceCriteria.then: the response is a 4xx with body error code `OAUTH2_MISSING_ID_TOKEN`; no session cookie is set; the audit log records one `oauth2.id_token_refused` event carrying provider id, reason class `missing`, and no token value
